metas.name: Inside Out
metas.description: Since they loved Inside Out 2, they will enjoy seeing where Riley's emotions first started.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: An exciting fantasy adventure with a heartwarming bond between a boy and a dragon, perfect for fans of Raya and the Last Dragon.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon 2
metas.description: Expands the wonderful dragon-riding world with even more emotional stakes and epic adventure.

metas.name: The Secret Life of Pets
metas.description: A hilarious look at what animals do when humans aren't home, matching the fun energy of Sing and Despicable Me.

metas.name: Despicable Me 2
metas.description: More minion mayhem and heartwarming family dynamics following the original Despicable Me.

metas.name: The Lion King
metas.description: The ultimate classic Disney masterpiece that sets up the world of Simba's Pride.

metas.name: Frozen
metas.description: If they loved Frozen II, they'll enjoy experiencing the magical beginning of Anna and Elsa's sisterly bond.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: A highly imaginative adventure through video game worlds, perfect for fans of Sonic and Mario.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: A clever, laugh-out-loud superhero comedy that matches the witty humor of Shrek.

metas.name: Monsters University
metas.description: A fun, colorful prequel showing how Mike and Sulley became best friends at college.

metas.name: Up
metas.description: A thrilling balloon-powered adventure filled with humor, heart, and a very lovable talking dog.

metas.name: The Incredibles
metas.description: A fast-paced, funny superhero family film with the same dynamic spirit as Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse.

metas.name: Paddington
metas.description: An incredibly charming and funny tale of a polite bear searching for a home, carrying the magical feel of Matilda.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: A widely acclaimed, joyful masterpiece about kindness and family that surpasses its predecessor.

metas.name: Minions
metas.description: A wacky and hilarious spin-off focusing on the lovable yellow helpers from Despicable Me.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 3
metas.description: Completes the epic trilogy with stunning animation, fantastic action, and wonderful family reunions.

metas.name: A Bug's Life
metas.description: A classic, charming Pixar adventure about a brave ant standing up for his colony, filled with humor.

metas.name: The Peanuts Movie
metas.description: A beautiful, heartwarming CGI transition of Charlie Brown and Snoopy that retains all its original wholesome charm.

metas.name: Shaun the Sheep Movie
metas.description: A brilliant, dialogue-free stop-motion comedy from the creators of Chicken Run that is pure joy for all ages.

metas.name: The Secret World of Arrietty
metas.description: A stunning Studio Ghibli adaptation of 'The Borrowers' that fits beautifully alongside My Neighbor Totoro.

metas.name: Onward
metas.description: A magical fantasy quest about brotherhood, filled with humor, D&D-style lore, and plenty of heart.

metas.name: Luca
metas.description: A sun-drenched, gorgeous Pixar story about friendship and summer adventures, highly reminiscent of Ponyo.

metas.name: Abominable
metas.description: A beautiful journey across China to return a magical Yeti to his family, perfect for fans of Tangled.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: A heartwarming superhero adventure about a boy and his lovable robot companion, Baymax.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: A wildly inventive and hilariously fast-paced comedy about a machine that makes food rain from the sky.

metas.name: Madagascar
metas.description: A laugh-out-loud adventure of zoo animals stranded in the wild, carrying the same fun comedic energy as Ice Age.

metas.name: The Croods
metas.description: A colorful, action-packed prehistoric family adventure that fans of Ice Age will absolutely love.

metas.name: Over the Moon
metas.description: A vibrant, musical fantasy rooted in Chinese mythology, perfect for fans of Coco and Moana.

metas.name: The Iron Giant
metas.description: A touching, classic animated sci-fi film about a boy who befriends a giant robot from outer space.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania
metas.description: A silly, upbeat family comedy about famous monsters, similar in vibe to Monsters, Inc.

metas.name: Babe
metas.description: A timeless, sweet live-action film about a polite little pig who learns to herd sheep.

metas.name: Night at the Museum
metas.description: An exciting live-action fantasy comedy where museum exhibits come to life, delivering endless family fun.

metas.name: Hook
metas.description: A magical, nostalgic live-action adventure that expands on the story of Peter Pan, perfect for fantasy lovers.

metas.name: Peter Pan
metas.description: The classic Disney flight to Neverland, perfect for kids who love magical and whimsical adventures.

metas.name: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
metas.description: A hilarious claymation mystery starring the beloved duo, perfect for fans of Wallace & Gromit: Vengeance Most Fowl.

metas.name: The Lego Movie
metas.description: An incredibly creative, hilarious, and action-packed adventure that speaks directly to a kid's imagination.

metas.name: Bolt
metas.description: A fun, action-filled Disney adventure about a dog who thinks he actually has superpowers.

metas.name: Mary Poppins
metas.description: A timeless, magical musical filled with unforgettable songs and whimsical live-action/animation hybrid scenes.

metas.name: Zathura: A Space Adventure
metas.description: An exciting, family-friendly space board-game adventure directed by Jon Favreau, great for fans of Jumanji-style thrills.
